class.name: StreamReplicationClient
class.brief_description: Client side of streaming-state replication: tracks ready cells and builds delta reports.
class.description: Reports are XOR deltas against the last version the server acknowledged through [method on_ack]. Call [method request_full] when the server answered [code]need_full[/code].

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns the version of the latest built report.

method.name: set_ready
method.description: Marks [param cell] ready or not ready.

method.name: request_full
method.description: Makes the next report a full one (base 0).

method.name: build_report
method.description: Builds the next report packet centred on [param center]. Use [method StreamReplication.serialize] for the wire format.

method.name: on_ack
method.description: Processes a server acknowledgement of version [param acked].

members.member: Radius of the reported window in cells.
